To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the class of real-time sequences generated by multiple tape Turing machines is strictly more powerful than the class of real- time sequences generated by multiple counter machines, and that the class of sequences generated by multiple time- and space-restricted counter machines is strictly more general than the class of sequences which can be generated by multiple time-restricted counter machines.

real-time Turing machines can do everything that real-time counter machines can do and a little more, that real-time Turing machine languages are closed under complementation, and that the classes of languages generated by time- restricted counter machines are strictly more powerful than the corresponding classes generated in the same amount of time by Turing machines.

(a) real-time Turing machines can generate all sequences which are generable by real-time counter machines; (b) real-time Turing counter machines can simulate real-time Turing machines; and (c) the classes of sequences which can be generated by real-time Turing and counter machines are incomparable with respect to the classes of sequences generated, respectively, by space-restricted and space- unrestricted Turing machines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following problems: 1) What is the relationship between time- and space-restriction on Turing machines and counter machines? 2) What is the power of real-time Turing machines?

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the class of sequences generated by space-restricted counter machines is the same as that generated by space-restricting Turing machines, while time- restriction on Turing machines is more powerful than time-restriction on counter machines.
real-time counter machines are strictly weaker than real-time Turing machines.
the classes of sequences generated in real time by time- and/or space- restricted multiple tape Turing machine, multiple counter machines, and finite automata are the same.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the class of real-time sequences is closed under the operation of concatenation, but is not closed under the operations of union, intersection or complement.
real-time Turing machines have more power than real-time counter-machines, but the difference is not great
time-restricted multiple tape Turing machines are strictly more powerful than time-restricted multiple counter machines, but the latter are more powerful than the former when space is restricted.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the power of real-time machines is not a function of the underlying computational model, but rather is a function of the time and space restrictions.

the class of real-time counter machines, which are known to generate only regular sequences, are strictly weaker than the class of real- time Turing machines, which are capable of generating nonregular sequences.
the power of time- and space-restricted counter machines is not always captured by their corresponding Turing machines.
